description: Return /api/sdk-security.json. Output is the SDK security document: schema_version, generated_at, disclaimer, description, count, and entries. count equals entries.length. Each entry has id, package, ecosystem (npm or github), minimum_safe_version (string or null), constraint (string or null), per_payment_cap_usd (number or null), formal_advisory_published (boolean or null), advisory_url (string or null), reported_at, fixed_at, origin_header_rejected_since, fixes, notes, source, related_urls, and verified_at. Null means the linked source does not state that field. The rows are @x402/fetch, @x402/axios, @x402/extensions, and @x402/svm at >=2.23.0, Eclair at >=0.14.5, and BTCPay Server with minimum_safe_version null because Optech #428 does not name a version. One unpaged document. Takes no parameters: call with an empty object. Use get_sdk_security instead of search_sources when you need the minimum version table. Use search_sources for the V12 post, Optech #428, and the Eclair release notes. Use /api/lightning-wallets.json and /api/lightning-releases.json for the wallet catalog and the stable node table; this tool does not return those files. A failed read returns isError. The text is the Error message. Free, no auth.
name: get_sdk_security
title: Read the SDK security registry
